image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a black audio cassette tape. The image focuses on the central hub area showing two white spools with magnetic tape wound around them. Above the spools is a paper label with handwritten text in black ink on a pinkish background. Below the spools is the bottom edge of the cassette casing with molded plastic details and holes.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The handwritten text on the label mimics the visual structure of writing but consists of nonsensical, illegible characters and pseudo-letters, a common AI artifact when rendering text.

artifact_observations.location: Black plastic casing, particularly the bottom edge
artifact_observations.reasoning: The plastic texture appears slightly noisy and grainy rather than smooth or uniformly molded, lacking the sharp specular highlights expected from hard plastic.

artifact_observations.location: Right edge of the label and top right corner
artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary between the label and the casing bleeds slightly, and the top right corner geometry seems to soften or merge into the background rather than maintaining a sharp edge.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly identified as a cassette tape and not a similar rectangular object.
To analyze the illegibility and structure of the handwritten text on the label, confirming if it is genuine writing or AI gibberish.
To check for edge bleeding between the label and the plastic casing, and to ensure the spools are topologically separate from the casing.
To assess the realism of the plastic textures and lighting reflections.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of handwritten text on the label
Sharpness of boundaries between label, casing, and spools
Realism of plastic material texture and reflections
Geometric consistency of spool windows and bottom slot
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the label. While it looks like handwriting, verify if the characters are structurally valid letters or just AI-generated scribbles. Also, inspect the transition between the white spools and the black casing for any haloing or fusion artifacts.
